To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the four electrode combined electro Fenton and electro photo Fenton systems are much more efficient than the single electrode electro Fenton and photofenton cells for the mineralization of the pharmaceutical b blocker Atenolol.

the combined electro Fenton systems using a carbon felt cathodes for Fe2+ recovery are more effective than the single electro Fenton cells for the complete mineralization of the pharmaceutical atenolol.

the use of a carbon felt cathodic material to electrogenerate H2O2 and to regenerate Fe2+ in a four electrode combined system enhances strongly the mineralization of atenolols in electro Fenton, whereas the use of UVA irradiation in photoelectro Feton does not cause significant improvements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new and more powerful systems for organic pollutants removal in water, which are based on electrochemical methods.
the development of a new four electrode combined cell for electro Fenton and a novel two electrode cell for photoelectro FENTON.
the development of novel combined cells for the degradation of organic pollutants with electro Fenton and/or photoelectro Fentons processes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the four electrode combined cells, with the same anode and cathode materials as the single cells but with a carbon felt instead of an air diffusion cathod

the combined systems are more efficient than the single cells to oxidize atenolol, mainly due to the fast and continuous regeneration of Fe2+, which enhances OH production and thus the degradation of aromatic intermediates and final carboxylylic acids.

the four electrode combined systems with an air diffusion cathodes for H2O 2 electrogeneration, a carbon felt cathodes for Fe2+ recovery and a boron doped anode, are the best option to mineralize atenolol and other pharmaceuticals in wastewater treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
electrochemical oxidation of atenolols is a promising technology for wastewater treatment.

the use of the combined four electrode cell with a boron doped carbon felt anode and an oxygen diffusion cathode is an interesting alternative to the single electro Fenton cell for the mineralization of organic pollutants in wastewaters.
the use of the four electrode combined cell is recommended for the electro Fenton degradation of organic pollutants in water.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combined electro Fenton system can be considered as an interesting alternative to the photo Fenton process to treat pharmaceutical compounds.
the four electrode combined systems are very promising for the treatment of pharmaceutical wastewaters containing b blockers and probably other pharmaceuticals.
the use of combined cells in electro Fenton processes allows to increase significantly the mineralization rate and the mineralization yield of atenolols, and to decrease the energy consumption.
